snippet.title: Splash: Underwater Sanctuary Trailer - November 2015 Relaunch
snippet.description:
Splash is reborn in this HUGE relaunch update. Not only do we have cool new features like Missions, but nearly every aspect of the game has been overhauled functionally and visually.

As a reef caretaker, the fate of a vibrant and diverse ecosystem is in your hands. Take the plunge and get it FREE on Google Play https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.runawayplay.splash&hl=en or the App Store https://itunes.apple.com/nz/app/splash-underwater-sanctuary/id960080321?mt=8

Join the Splash Community on Facebook! https://www.facebook.com/splashunderwatersanctuary/
